text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~ For Cheval-chi's reward~...
I guess a present would be best after all?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Cheval-chi might dislike going on a date.
If it's a present, she'll definitely accept it if I just leave it quietly...!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: (I already know the kinds of things Cheval-chi would want... Yup, decided~♪)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Present setting, all okay♪
Cheval-chi should be passing by right about now...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Here she comes! Time to hide~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...This package, is it for me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eh... This hat care kit...
is the one I've wanted for so long...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The sender is... blank...
But this handwriting and glittery pen is...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu~ Cheval-chi looks happy♡
The reward is a huge success~♪)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: (Now, time to prep the next one, prep~!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Next is fishing wear, huh...
But why do something like this...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Are you... somewhere nearby...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(H-Huh?
Isn't her reaction a bit lukewarm...?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: (Could it be that I messed up picking the present...?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(But the next one! She'll definitely love the next one!
I'm super confident in it!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A limited edition meat bun set...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "Cheval-chi is amazing!", huh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(...She doesn't look happy at all.
Eh, why, why~!?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: (If even that didn't make her happy, does that mean—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You're right there, aren't you, Vivlos?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Aha, you found me out♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I wanted to make a surprise entrance at the very end to shock you though~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you know,
I really wasn't trying to tease you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to give Cheval-chi a nice reward
for working so hard. So that's why—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I looked up all sorts of things!
Ehehe, I tried really hard, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For the meat buns and stuff, I woke up early and waited in line!
All just to make Cheval-chi happy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: But…… you didn't really like it……?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……No.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then—!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering what you were up to at first,
but... I could tell how hard you worked for this……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……And your feelings really reached me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So, um…………
thank you, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ……! Yeah…… yay!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, which present made you
the happiest? Was it the meat bun after all!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I stood in line forever for that! I decorated the card too
to make it super cute! Did you see it!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I get it, so please……!
Let go of—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way♡ Tell me all your thoughts~
Che~val-chi~~♡
